description: This Java class 'CardFlip' is an Android activity that manages a card flipping animation demo with two stacks of cards, handling gestures for flipping and rotating cards with animations.

classes.name: CardFlip
classes.description: Main activity managing card stack animations and gesture interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up card stacks, gesture detector, and layout.

methods.name: addNewCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specified stack with layout parameters.

methods.name: getStack
methods.description: Determines which stack a touch event occurred in based on X coordinate.

methods.name: rotateCardView
methods.description: Handles flipping a card based on gesture velocity and updates its stack.

methods.name: rotateCards
methods.description: Animates a stack of cards to rotate in or out around a corner.

methods.name: rotateCardsFullRotation
methods.description: Animates a full rotation of all cards in a stack around a corner.
